scenarios.name: Collapse and expands a feature branch

scenario_steps.name: a part document with an expanded Extrusion1 branch is open in the MCAD Software
the model browser shows its Sketch1 child
the user collapses the Extrusion1 branch
the Sketch1 child is hidden from the browser
the solid remains displayed in the viewport
the user expands the Extrusion1 branch
the Sketch1 child is shown beneath Extrusion1
the solid remains displayed in the viewport
